sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS, RISER AND DETAIL
sheets.reading_notes: Cover/legend sheet. Contains full abbreviations list, symbol legend, equipment support detail (2x6 pressure-treated lumber backboard on 36" concrete-set posts), and power riser diagram. Riser shows: SMECO pad-mount transformer (by SMECO) → SMECO meter/meterbase → ATS-1 240/120V 1φ → Panel MDP (175A MCB, 240/120V, 1φ, 3-wire, 22 kAIC, NEMA 3R surface/rack mount) → sub-panels GH1, GH2, GH3 (each fed via separate feeders) → 41kW propane generator with concrete pad. Two 4" empty conduits stubbed for SMECO future use. Firm: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc., 6353 Center Dr, Norfolk VA 23502 / 1420 Great Bridge Blvd, Chesapeake VA 23320. Engineer seal Lic. No. 048025. Project No. 23-017.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at 1"=20'-0" scale. Shows three new greenhouses (GH1, GH2, GH3) arranged in row, with existing wood shop and existing greenhouse to north. Equipment rack/incoming service location shown at northwest corner of greenhouse cluster. Generator and concrete pad shown between GH2 and GH3. Proposed SMECO transformer location shown. Primary routing shown (UE — underground electrical) from proposed SMECO transformer to equipment rack. Conduit runs labeled UE throughout site. Site context shows trees/landscaping, two pond-like features to southwest. Dashed line encloses the three new greenhouse footprints.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Floor plan at 1/8"=1'-0" scale showing all three greenhouses side by side. GH1 (left, 30×100), GH2 (center, 30×100), GH3 (right, 30×50). Each greenhouse shows panel location (GH1-x, GH2-x, GH3-x circuit designations), receptacle and device layout. Construction Notes (THIS SHEET ONLY) enumerate equipment: (1) meter and meterbase, (2) 24" exhaust fan 3.2A 120V, (3) ATS-1 240/120V 1φ, (4) Panel MDP, (5) 41kW propane generator, (6) vent motor 4.0A 120V, (7) Panel GH1, (8) Panel GH2, (9) Panel GH3, (10) 20" HAR fan 1.0A 120V, (11) 36" exhaust fan 5.2A 120V, (12) 80K BTU unit heater 4.7A 120V, (13) 160K BTU unit heater 5.1A 120V, (14) sump pump 3.0A 120V, (15) screen motor 4.0A 120V, (16) dehumidifier 12.4A 240V, (17) NTAKE damper 0.5A 120V, (18) 42" exhaust fan 4.7A 240V, (19) generator battery charger 6A 120V, (20) generator jacket heater 8.3A 120V. Lighting by owner/customer-provided contractor-installed. MDP-18 and MDP-20 breakers visible feeding GH sub-panels.

sheets.title: PANELBOARD SCHEDULES
sheets.reading_notes: Four panelboard schedules on one sheet. MDP: 175A MCB, 240/120V, 1 phase, 3 wire, 22 kAIC, NEMA 3R surface/rack mount; feeds Panel GH1 (46.5A), Panel GH2 (46.5A), Panel GH3 (41.5A), plus battery charger (gen) 6.0A and jacket heater (gen) 8.3A; total connected load A:134.5 B:96.3, connected amps A:140.5 B:104.6. GH1 and GH2: each 100A MLO, 240/120V, 1 phase, 3 wire, 22 kAIC, NEMA 3R surface mount; loads include circulation fans, 36" exhaust fans, 160K BTU heaters, dehumidifiers, lighting, vent motors, sump pumps, 42-fan (GH2 only), receptacles; total A:28.6/B:20.6 each, connected amps A:46.5/B:33.5. GH3: 100A MLO, 240/120V, 1 phase, 3 wire, 22 kAIC, NEMA 3R; loads include circulation fans, 36" exhaust fan, 80K BTU heater, dehumidifier, lighting, 24" exhaust fan, vent motor, sump pump, screen motor, intake damper; total A:29.0/B:25.8, connected amps A:41.5/B:29.3. Note on all schedules: coordinate available fault current with SMECO.

sheets.title: SPECIFICATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Full electrical specifications sheet. Covers: Part 1 General (submittals, products, receptacles, switches, SD-03 data), Part 2 Products (conduit/fittings, wiring devices, splices/terminations, lockout requirements, manufacturer nameplate requirements), Part 3 Execution (installation, wiring methods, receptacle installation, conduit installation, mounting, grounding, equipment connections, field quality control including 600V wiring test and ground-fault receptacle test). Specs reference NEC, NFPA 70, UL listed equipment, NEMA standards. Notes: minimum 12 AWG for branch circuits, minimum 10 AWG for class 1 remote control; color coding specified (Phase A=Black, Phase B=Red). GRS conduit for indoor/outdoor; PVC SCH40 allowed per plans. Receptacles are GFCI weatherproof 20A 125VAC duplex. All equipment factory-applied finish per NFPA 250.
